title: Healthcare Assistant
description:
Healthcare Assistant Days (AV2068 B)

Location: Near Corbridge (NE44)
Pay: £14.27 per hour
Hours: 12hr shifts (Days or Nights) ideally 4 shifts per week, including weekends on rotation

Make a Difference Every Day

An excellent opportunity for a caring and compassionate Healthcare Assistant to join a beautiful care home near Corbridge.

Our client is looking for someone with a positive attitude and a genuine passion for supporting others. Previous experience is beneficial, but the right approach to care is what matters most.

What's on Offer?
- £14.27 per hour
- Full-time, guaranteed hours
- Free uniform
- Free meals on shift
- Ongoing training and development
- Contributory pension scheme
- Supportive employer with opportunities to develop your career

About You

We're looking for someone who is caring, reliable and committed to delivering high-quality, person-centred care.

Due to the rural location, access to your own transport is an advantage.

Please note: Applicants must already have full, unrestricted right to work in the UK. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Apply Today

Join a care provider that values its team and supports your career. Apply now to find out more.
